title: Empirical Fourier estimate
statement: Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $x_1,\ldots,x_m$ be points of the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, and let $U\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$. The empirical Fourier estimate is $\frac{1}{m}\sum_{i=1}^m f(\chi(x_i))\,\chi_U(\chi(x_i))$, where $\chi$ is the coordinatewise sign map and $\chi_U$ is the character indexed by $U$.
hypotheses_covered: A real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube.
A sample indexed by the $m$-element set, with each point in the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube.
